meta.title: Clash
meta.description: After the dust clears, the only distinct thing in the data turbulence is that unyielding form.

units.rawText: Outside the Cyclopes Sector firewall.
units.displayText: Outside the Cyclopes Sector firewall.

spans.text: Outside the Cyclopes Sector firewall.

units.rawText: We might have an invitation, but we don't have entry permission from the administrator... So how exactly are we supposed to get in?
units.displayText: We might have an invitation, but we don't have entry permission from the administrator... So how exactly are we supposed to get in?

spans.text: We might have an invitation, but we don't have entry permission from the administrator... So how exactly are we supposed to get in?

units.rawText: Don't worry about that. The Com... The Professor and I sent advance notice of our visit, and this concert tour has the full support of the Oasis.
units.displayText: Don't worry about that. The Com... The Professor and I sent advance notice of our visit, and this concert tour has the full support of the Oasis.

spans.text: Don't worry about that. The Com... The Professor and I sent advance notice of our visit, and this concert tour has the full support of the Oasis.

units.rawText: The Professor's always been a rational person. I can't believe they would go this far to humor us.
units.displayText: The Professor's always been a rational person. I can't believe they would go this far to humor us.

spans.text: The Professor's always been a rational person. I can't believe they would go this far to humor us.

units.rawText: Well, the Professor will always back us up from the shadows no matter what we get up to.
units.displayText: Well, the Professor will always back us up from the shadows no matter what we get up to.

spans.text: Well, the Professor will always back us up from the shadows no matter what we get up to.

units.rawText: I've already sent a request. They should have contacted the Cyclopes administrator ahead of time and gotten entry permission for us.
units.displayText: I've already sent a request. They should have contacted the Cyclopes administrator ahead of time and gotten entry permission for us.

spans.text: I've already sent a request. They should have contacted the Cyclopes administrator ahead of time and gotten entry permission for us.

units.rawText: Several seconds later, her terminal beeps with a "message received" tone. The firewall password appears on the display, and Clukay enters each character into the firewall. The operand fragments on its surface glow in a chaotic pattern before the barrier opens for them.
units.displayText: Several seconds later, her terminal beeps with a "message received" tone. The firewall password appears on the display, and Clukay enters each character into the firewall. The operand fragments on its surface glow in a chaotic pattern before the barrier opens for them.

spans.text: Several seconds later, her terminal beeps with a "message received" tone. The firewall password appears on the display, and Clukay enters each character into the firewall. The operand fragments on its surface glow in a chaotic pattern before the barrier opens for them.

units.rawText: After entering the sector, the group finds themselves amidst a scarred landscape. They have no idea how to proceed.
units.displayText: After entering the sector, the group finds themselves amidst a scarred landscape. They have no idea how to proceed.

spans.text: After entering the sector, the group finds themselves amidst a scarred landscape. They have no idea how to proceed.

units.rawText: If the invitation was genuine, then why is nobody here? They didn't even send anyone to guide us in... As I thought, it was bogus...
units.displayText: If the invitation was genuine, then why is nobody here? They didn't even send anyone to guide us in... As I thought, it was bogus...

spans.text: If the invitation was genuine, then why is nobody here? They didn't even send anyone to guide us in... As I thought, it was bogus...

units.rawText: But then why would they target 4You? Wouldn't going after the Professor directly be more productive?
units.displayText: But then why would they target 4You? Wouldn't going after the Professor directly be more productive?

spans.text: But then why would they target 4You? Wouldn't going after the Professor directly be more productive?

units.rawText: Shhh—I hear footsteps.
units.displayText: Shhh—I hear footsteps.

spans.text: Shhh—I hear footsteps.

units.rawText: Clukay quickly moves in front of her teammates and gestures for them to take cover. Through a small crack, she spots an agent patrol doing a recon sweep of the area.
units.displayText: Clukay quickly moves in front of her teammates and gestures for them to take cover. Through a small crack, she spots an agent patrol doing a recon sweep of the area.

spans.text: Clukay quickly moves in front of her teammates and gestures for them to take cover. Through a small crack, she spots an agent patrol doing a recon sweep of the area.

units.rawText: Illegal firewall access detected at coordinates (α 50.14, β 47.68, γ41.15)...
units.displayText: Illegal firewall access detected at coordinates (α 50.14, β 47.68, γ41.15)...

spans.text: Illegal firewall access detected at coordinates (α 50.14, β 47.68, γ41.15)...

units.rawText: Everyone holds their breath and watches as the patrolling agents sweep their scanner beams over 4You's position.
units.displayText: Everyone holds their breath and watches as the patrolling agents sweep their scanner beams over 4You's position.

spans.text: Everyone holds their breath and watches as the patrolling agents sweep their scanner beams over 4You's position.

units.rawText:
[Scanning Area...]
Thermal readings nominal.
No radar contacts.
units.displayText:
[Scanning Area...]
Thermal readings nominal.
No radar contacts.

spans.text:
[Scanning Area...]
Thermal readings nominal.
No radar contacts.

units.rawText: Monitor104, we have not conducted a full sweep of this area yet. Proceeding to another area right now would be rash.
units.displayText: Monitor104, we have not conducted a full sweep of this area yet. Proceeding to another area right now would be rash.

spans.text: Monitor104, we have not conducted a full sweep of this area yet. Proceeding to another area right now would be rash.

units.rawText: The targets are no longer in the current area. Time is critical, and in order to improve our search efficiency, I recommend we search other possible areas.
units.displayText: The targets are no longer in the current area. Time is critical, and in order to improve our search efficiency, I recommend we search other possible areas.

spans.text: The targets are no longer in the current area. Time is critical, and in order to improve our search efficiency, I recommend we search other possible areas.

units.rawText: Order received.
units.displayText: Order received.

spans.text: Order received.

units.rawText: The agent called Monitor104 glances at 4You's hiding place before leading her team away. After the patrol team vanishes into the distance, Vee slowly gets to her feet.
units.displayText: The agent called Monitor104 glances at 4You's hiding place before leading her team away. After the patrol team vanishes into the distance, Vee slowly gets to her feet.

spans.text: The agent called Monitor104 glances at 4You's hiding place before leading her team away. After the patrol team vanishes into the distance, Vee slowly gets to her feet.

units.rawText: The optical camo that Fresnel developed really is something. We'd have been spotted by now if it wasn't for this.
units.displayText: The optical camo that Fresnel developed really is something. We'd have been spotted by now if it wasn't for this.

spans.text: The optical camo that Fresnel developed really is something. We'd have been spotted by now if it wasn't for this.

units.rawText: I guess we should be glad that technology like this hasn't spread to Cyclopes yet. It's saved us some unnecessary trouble.
units.displayText: I guess we should be glad that technology like this hasn't spread to Cyclopes yet. It's saved us some unnecessary trouble.

spans.text: I guess we should be glad that technology like this hasn't spread to Cyclopes yet. It's saved us some unnecessary trouble.

units.rawText: No, we're not out of the woods yet.
units.displayText: No, we're not out of the woods yet.

spans.text: No, we're not out of the woods yet.

units.rawText: Hm?
units.displayText: Hm?

spans.text: Hm?

units.rawText: <size=40>Found you.</size>
units.displayText: Found you.

spans.text: Found you.

units.rawText: Vee! Take cover!!!
units.displayText: Vee! Take cover!!!

spans.text: Vee! Take cover!!!

units.rawText: Vee immediately jumps back as she hears a calm, youthful voice speaking from beside her. A dazzling ray of light slices through the air and Vee instinctively twists her head aside mid-leap. This action saves her from the operand laser, but it still singes a few strands of hair on the left side of her head.
units.displayText: Vee immediately jumps back as she hears a calm, youthful voice speaking from beside her. A dazzling ray of light slices through the air and Vee instinctively twists her head aside mid-leap. This action saves her from the operand laser, but it still singes a few strands of hair on the left side of her head.

This action saves her from the operand laser, but it still singes a few strands of hair on the left side of her head.

units.rawText: Clukay rushes out and grabs Vee's forearm, then tosses her to Centaureissi, who's waiting in cover. Monitor104 freezes up at Clukay's sudden appearance and misses the chance to press the attack. After hesitating briefly, she puts down her laser gun and begins calling for help.
units.displayText: Clukay rushes out and grabs Vee's forearm, then tosses her to Centaureissi, who's waiting in cover. Monitor104 freezes up at Clukay's sudden appearance and misses the chance to press the attack. After hesitating briefly, she puts down her laser gun and begins calling for help.

units.rawText: 4 trespassing agents detected at Firewall Area D3, coordinates (α 50.14, β 47.68, γ41.15). Requesting backup!
units.displayText: 4 trespassing agents detected at Firewall Area D3, coordinates (α 50.14, β 47.68, γ41.15). Requesting backup!

spans.text: 4 trespassing agents detected at Firewall Area D3, coordinates (α 50.14, β 47.68, γ41.15). Requesting backup!

units.rawText: Is this how you welcome guests in the Cyclopes Sector? You send an "invitation" and then set an ambush near the firewall?
units.displayText: Is this how you welcome guests in the Cyclopes Sector? You send an "invitation" and then set an ambush near the firewall?

spans.text: Is this how you welcome guests in the Cyclopes Sector? You send an "invitation" and then set an ambush near the firewall?

units.rawText: Monitor104 cannot verify your signatures and cannot confirm that this is indeed legal access.
units.displayText: Monitor104 cannot verify your signatures and cannot confirm that this is indeed legal access.

spans.text: Monitor104 cannot verify your signatures and cannot confirm that this is indeed legal access.

units.rawText: High-powered weaponry detected on trespassing agents. Switching to disarmament mode, executing elimination order.
units.displayText: High-powered weaponry detected on trespassing agents. Switching to disarmament mode, executing elimination order.

spans.text: High-powered weaponry detected on trespassing agents. Switching to disarmament mode, executing elimination order.

units.rawText: The sound of a weapon chambering a round is exceptionally loud during this standoff, and Monitor104 aims her weapon at Clukay.
units.displayText: The sound of a weapon chambering a round is exceptionally loud during this standoff, and Monitor104 aims her weapon at Clukay.

spans.text: The sound of a weapon chambering a round is exceptionally loud during this standoff, and Monitor104 aims her weapon at Clukay.

units.rawText: Looks like we're past the point of talking.
units.displayText: Looks like we're past the point of talking.

spans.text: Looks like we're past the point of talking.

units.rawText: (She had a team with her just now, so why is she alone right now? Are they setting up an ambush?)
units.displayText: She had a team with her just now, so why is she alone right now? Are they setting up an ambush?

spans.text: She had a team with her just now, so why is she alone right now? Are they setting up an ambush?

units.rawText: <size=40>Commencing elimination!</size>
units.displayText: Commencing elimination!

spans.text: Commencing elimination!

units.rawText: The word "elimination" seems to be both a final warning to Clukay and also a declaration of her own resolve. The agent instinctively pulls the trigger and a powerful operand laser lances out from her weapon, instantly piercing through the ruined wall behind Clukay.
units.displayText: The word "elimination" seems to be both a final warning to Clukay and also a declaration of her own resolve. The agent instinctively pulls the trigger and a powerful operand laser lances out from her weapon, instantly piercing through the ruined wall behind Clukay.

spans.text: The word "elimination" seems to be both a final warning to Clukay and also a declaration of her own resolve. The agent instinctively pulls the trigger and a powerful operand laser lances out from her weapon, instantly piercing through the ruined wall behind Clukay.

units.rawText: Clukay throws herself to the right. She plants a foot on a nearby wall and launches herself forward and past the agent. This movement is so quick that the agent can't lock onto Clukay in time and the only thing her wild barrage hits is after-images of her opponent.
units.displayText: Clukay throws herself to the right. She plants a foot on a nearby wall and launches herself forward and past the agent. This movement is so quick that the agent can't lock onto Clukay in time and the only thing her wild barrage hits is after-images of her opponent.

spans.text: Clukay throws herself to the right. She plants a foot on a nearby wall and launches herself forward and past the agent. This movement is so quick that the agent can't lock onto Clukay in time and the only thing her wild barrage hits is after-images of her opponent.

units.rawText: Your movements and marksmanship are textbook, but you're nothing but an amateur compared to a proper Battle-type agent.
units.displayText: Your movements and marksmanship are textbook, but you're nothing but an amateur compared to a proper Battle-type agent.

spans.text: Your movements and marksmanship are textbook, but you're nothing but an amateur compared to a proper Battle-type agent.

units.rawText: Clukay flicks her gun's safety on, then reverses her weapon and drives the butt into the agent's elbow joint. A wave of numbness spreads out from the impact site and her hand immediately goes slack, the operand laser dropping to the gravel.
units.displayText: Clukay flicks her gun's safety on, then reverses her weapon and drives the butt into the agent's elbow joint. A wave of numbness spreads out from the impact site and her hand immediately goes slack, the operand laser dropping to the gravel.

spans.text: Clukay flicks her gun's safety on, then reverses her weapon and drives the butt into the agent's elbow joint. A wave of numbness spreads out from the impact site and her hand immediately goes slack, the operand laser dropping to the gravel.

units.rawText: [Warning] Weapon connection anomaly.
units.displayText: [Warning] Weapon connection anomaly.

spans.text: [Warning] Weapon connection anomaly.

units.rawText: Clukay points her gun at the agent's head to caution her against picking her weapon up again and causing unnecessary trouble. However...
units.displayText: Clukay points her gun at the agent's head to caution her against picking her weapon up again and causing unnecessary trouble. However...

spans.text: Clukay points her gun at the agent's head to caution her against picking her weapon up again and causing unnecessary trouble. However...

units.rawText: Release Monitor104!
units.displayText: Release Monitor104!

spans.text: Release Monitor104!

units.rawText: The other members of her patrol team have been watching this series of events. A frantic look comes over the agent at their head and she runs in front of Monitor104, spreading her arms out to block Clukay.
units.displayText: The other members of her patrol team have been watching this series of events. A frantic look comes over the agent at their head and she runs in front of Monitor104, spreading her arms out to block Clukay.

spans.text: The other members of her patrol team have been watching this series of events. A frantic look comes over the agent at their head and she runs in front of Monitor104, spreading her arms out to block Clukay.

units.rawText: These movements... I don't recall Battle-type agents moving like that.
units.displayText: These movements... I don't recall Battle-type agents moving like that.

spans.text: These movements... I don't recall Battle-type agents moving like that.

units.rawText: Battle-type agents' base layer logic is to kill their opponents, so protecting their comrades like this is definitely unusual.
units.displayText: Battle-type agents' base layer logic is to kill their opponents, so protecting their comrades like this is definitely unusual.

spans.text: Battle-type agents' base layer logic is to kill their opponents, so protecting their comrades like this is definitely unusual.

units.rawText: Large number of trespassing agents detected at Firewall Area D3, coordinates (α 50.14, β 47.68, γ41.15). Requesting backup!
units.displayText: Large number of trespassing agents detected at Firewall Area D3, coordinates (α 50.14, β 47.68, γ41.15). Requesting backup!

spans.text: Large number of trespassing agents detected at Firewall Area D3, coordinates (α 50.14, β 47.68, γ41.15). Requesting backup!

units.rawText: We come from the Oasis. We received an invitation from your sector to hold a concert here. We have never once harbored malicious intent.
units.displayText: We come from the Oasis. We received an invitation from your sector to hold a concert here. We have never once harbored malicious intent.

spans.text: We come from the Oasis. We received an invitation from your sector to hold a concert here. We have never once harbored malicious intent.

units.rawText:
[Verifying...]
[Verification complete.]
units.displayText:
[Verifying...]
[Verification complete.]

spans.text:
[Verifying...]
[Verification complete.]

units.rawText: That's impossible. The Professor requested and received permission for entry from your administrator. We even received an access code for the Cyclopes Sector firewall.
units.displayText: That's impossible. The Professor requested and received permission for entry from your administrator. We even received an access code for the Cyclopes Sector firewall.

spans.text: That's impossible. The Professor requested and received permission for entry from your administrator. We even received an access code for the Cyclopes Sector firewall.

units.rawText: Clukay tightens her grip on her gun. The other agents from the patrol squad tense up.
units.displayText: Clukay tightens her grip on her gun. The other agents from the patrol squad tense up.

spans.text: Clukay tightens her grip on her gun. The other agents from the patrol squad tense up.

units.rawText: This is <color=orange>Sortie002-369</color>, here to assist.
units.displayText: This is Sortie002-369, here to assist.

spans.text: This is
Sortie002-369
, here to assist.

units.rawText: Sortie002-369, they claim to be agents from the Oasis, but we didn't receive any information about their arrival.
units.displayText: Sortie002-369, they claim to be agents from the Oasis, but we didn't receive any information about their arrival.

spans.text: Sortie002-369, they claim to be agents from the Oasis, but we didn't receive any information about their arrival.

units.rawText: The Oasis again...
units.displayText: The Oasis again...

spans.text: The Oasis again...

units.rawText: The use of "again" sounds very significant. Have you had contact with other agents from the Oasis?
units.displayText: The use of "again" sounds very significant. Have you had contact with other agents from the Oasis?

spans.text: The use of "again" sounds very significant. Have you had contact with other agents from the Oasis?

units.rawText: Nameless recalls his unhappy encounter with a certain folklorist and frowns.
units.displayText: Nameless recalls his unhappy encounter with a certain folklorist and frowns.

spans.text: Nameless recalls his unhappy encounter with a certain folklorist and frowns.

units.rawText: Monitor104, this is probably a misunderstanding. Olivia sent the entry notification and reception instructions to Sortie104 three days ago.
units.displayText: Monitor104, this is probably a misunderstanding. Olivia sent the entry notification and reception instructions to Sortie104 three days ago.

spans.text: Monitor104, this is probably a misunderstanding. Olivia sent the entry notification and reception instructions to Sortie104 three days ago.

units.rawText: Sortie104...
units.displayText: Sortie104...

spans.text: Sortie104...

units.rawText: I'm sure you know what state she's in. She's in no condition to send you anything at the moment, so she couldn't share the visitor information with you. Fortunately things didn't escalate too much.
units.displayText: I'm sure you know what state she's in. She's in no condition to send you anything at the moment, so she couldn't share the visitor information with you. Fortunately things didn't escalate too much.

spans.text: I'm sure you know what state she's in. She's in no condition to send you anything at the moment, so she couldn't share the visitor information with you. Fortunately things didn't escalate too much.

units.rawText: "Too much"? If you'd come any later, half the sector would be in ruins by now.
units.displayText: "Too much"? If you'd come any later, half the sector would be in ruins by now.

spans.text: "Too much"? If you'd come any later, half the sector would be in ruins by now.

units.rawText: If you don't mind, why don't I take you to a place run by a friend of mine? It might be more suitable for reminiscing about the past.
units.displayText: If you don't mind, why don't I take you to a place run by a friend of mine? It might be more suitable for reminiscing about the past.

spans.text: If you don't mind, why don't I take you to a place run by a friend of mine? It might be more suitable for reminiscing about the past.

units.rawText: No signs of Irregular Agents detected. Trespassers have left the intrusion point. This is Monitor104 of Patrol Squad 104, requesting permission to sweep other suspicious areas.
units.displayText: No signs of Irregular Agents detected. Trespassers have left the intrusion point. This is Monitor104 of Patrol Squad 104, requesting permission to sweep other suspicious areas.

spans.text: No signs of Irregular Agents detected. Trespassers have left the intrusion point. This is Monitor104 of Patrol Squad 104, requesting permission to sweep other suspicious areas.

units.rawText: One of the beams hits an electrical device, which explodes in a burst of electromagnetic disruption. Despite taking cover behind the rubble, 4You ends up getting caught in it, too.
units.displayText: One of the beams hits an electrical device, which explodes in a burst of electromagnetic disruption. Despite taking cover behind the rubble, 4You ends up getting caught in it, too.

spans.text: One of the beams hits an electrical device, which explodes in a burst of electromagnetic disruption. Despite taking cover behind the rubble, 4You ends up getting caught in it, too.

units.rawText: There are no notices of a legal idol group holding a concert here in recent sector notifications. The administrator did not issue any requests for entertainment activities to other sectors, either.
units.displayText: There are no notices of a legal idol group holding a concert here in recent sector notifications. The administrator did not issue any requests for entertainment activities to other sectors, either.

spans.text: There are no notices of a legal idol group holding a concert here in recent sector notifications. The administrator did not issue any requests for entertainment activities to other sectors, either.

units.rawText: As the standoff drags on, a voice booms out from the distance. The speaker's flame-red hair stands out against the monochrome debris. His towering frame and his weighty shield obscure what little light manages to filter through the ruins.
